### [Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/23/kimi-k31-pro/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-10-23

Moonshot launched Kimi K3.1 Pro via API, promising open-weight release by November 4, 2026, alongside a faster Highspeed variant.

- API pricing is set at $2.00 per million input tokens and $10.00 per million output tokens, with a Highspeed variant offered at 2-3x speed for double the cost.
- Artificial Analysis gave Kimi K3.1 Pro a score of 55, placing it ahead of Claude Fable 5.1 (53), GPT-6 Astra (53), and Gemini 4 Argon (53).
- Supports three explicit reasoning levels (low, medium, and max) via OpenAI-compatible API endpoints.
- Moonshot claims full open weights will be released by November 4, 2026.

**Why it matters:** Kimi K3.1 Pro represents the first time a model scheduled for an open-weight release has achieved benchmark performance competitive with top-tier proprietary frontier models.
